title: Stabilization of finite abelian stage families
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be stage precoverages [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed base-change and composition stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Suppose every covering presieve has finitely many arrows, transition functors send covers to covers, preserve pullbacks of covering arrows, and are continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone with object and arrow set cocones colimiting [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite closure, isomorphism-cover, and covering-pullback properties. Assume its covers are exactly transported stage covers, each $V_j$ preserves covering pullbacks and is continuous. Fix $i$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $A_t=F(t.hom)^{-1}G$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, and $H=V_i^{-1}G$. Let $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^*H$ be sheaf morphisms whose composites with the stage adjunction units agree, componentwise as arrows, with the $V_i$ adjunction unit. Fix $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, an object $W\in F(t.right)$, a covering presieve $T\in P_{t.right}(W)$ and an $A_t$-valued family $y$ on $T$. Suppose the family $g\mapsto\alpha_t(y_g)$ is compatible on $T$ as a family in the restriction of $H$ along $V_t$. Then there exist $t'\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $W'\in F(t'.right)$, a cover $T'\in P_{t'.right}(W')$, an equality $h:V_{t'}W'=V_tW$, and a compatible $A_{t'}$-valued family $y'$ on $T'$ such that for every $g':Z'\to W'$ in $T'$ there are $g:Z\to W$ in $T$ and $r:V_{t'}Z'\to V_tZ$ with $V_{t'}(g')\circ h=r\circ V_t(g)$ and $\alpha_{t'}(y'_{g'})=H(r)(\alpha_t(y_g))$. No sieve or generated-section family on the colimit site is given, and no global amalgamation is asserted.

proof.text: Since the stage cover T is finite, form its finitely many pairwise covering pullbacks. Apply hy to each pullback square: the two restricted sections have equal alpha images. Their difference therefore has zero alpha image.

Use the unit-compatible uniqueness isomorphism for composite left adjoints to express alpha as the cocone inverse-image unit of A_t followed by a composition isomorphism. Its injectivity on sections shows that the cocone unit kills each difference. Apply finite source-unit zero detection to the source sheaf A_t, the corresponding covering-pullback object, and that difference. This gives a transition unit killing the difference. The analogous stage composition isomorphism identifies this with equality of the canonically transitioned restrictions.

The transition maps are transposes of direct units. Uniqueness of adjuncts gives their composition laws and their compatibility with alpha. Filteredness of Under i puts the finitely many vanishing equations at a single common refinement. Preservation of covering pullbacks identifies them with the pullback compatibility equations of the transitioned indexed family. Hence this family is compatible, and duplicate image arrows have equal values, yielding y' on the transported presieve T'. The latter covers by hcover.

Cocone naturality supplies h and the factorization of each new arrow through an old one. The unit compatibility and naturality give the asserted alpha-image restriction formula. If T is empty, take its empty family at the identity refinement; it is compatible without any equations.

If the finite presieve is nonempty, apply the nonempty-cover stabilization theorem; if it is empty, retain the same stage and use the empty family, whose compatibility and factorization obligations are vacuous.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A35; reduction to the nonempty finite-cover case and vacuous empty case

theorem colimit_site_abelian_finite_family_stabilization
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (t : Under i) (W : F.obj t.right) (T : Presieve W) (hT : T ∈ P t.right W)
    (y : T.FamilyOfElements
      (((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⋙
          forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hy : (show T.FamilyOfElements
        ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙
          (ColimitSiteStageImage.target F P V Q i G).obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) from
        fun {Z} g hg ↦ (α t).hom.app (op Z) (y g hg)).Compatible) :
    ∃ (t' : Under i) (W' : F.obj t'.right) (T' : Presieve W'), T' ∈ P t'.right W' ∧
      ∃ (hW : (V.ι.app t'.right).toFunctor.obj W' = (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj W)
        (y' : T'.FamilyOfElements
          (((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⋙
              forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})),
        y'.Compatible ∧ ∀ {Z' : F.obj t'.right} (g' : Z' ⟶ W') (hg' : T' g'),
          ∃ (Z : F.obj t.right) (g : Z ⟶ W) (hg : T g)
            (r : (V.ι.app t'.right).toFunctor.obj Z' ⟶ (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj Z),
            (V.ι.app t'.right).toFunctor.map g' ≫ eqToHom hW =
              r ≫ (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map g ∧
            (α t').hom.app (op Z') (y' g' hg') =
              (ColimitSiteStageImage.target F P V Q i G).obj.map r.op
                ((α t).hom.app (op Z) (y g hg))
